info.title: crap4csharp
info.description: CRAP metric analyzer for C# — port of crap4java.

options.name: --path
options.description:
Workspace root (default: current directory).
A .sln/.csproj file resolves to its directory.

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the report to <file> too (dirs created).

options.name: --threshold
options.description: CRAP gate (default 8.0). Fails with exit 2 when max > n.

options.name: --top
options.description: Show only the n worst methods.

options.name: --min-cc
options.description: Hide methods with complexity below n (default 1).

options.name: --no-coverage
options.description: Skip 'dotnet test' coverage run; reuse existing XML.

options.name: --changed
options.description: Analyze changed C# files under <root>/src/ (git status)
